rules: Every state has an icon AND words. Color is never the only signal.
Approved never looks like sent. Sent never looks like delivered.
A pending marker (anything not terminal and not delivered) is shown on the card and in the Outbox tab badge, and is restored after a restart.
Approve is only offered in business state 'proposed'. Every other state offers at most revoke, view evidence or ask someone.
The SIMULATED label is shown on every card whose recipient.channel is 'simulated'.

Business state and transport state are shown as two separate lines. The transport line is shown whenever transport != none, in ANY business state: a revoked action can still show 'sent' or 'delivered' when a late carrier receipt arrives.

Revoke is an owner act: it uses the same confirm screen as approve. It is a guaranteed recall only while transport is none, queued or failed; while sending or send_unknown it only stops new attempts, and the button says so (action.revoke.may_be_sent).
